component.name: WhatsDown
component.summary: Native Linux WhatsApp client built with GTK 4 and Libadwaita

description.p: WhatsDown is a modern, responsive WhatsApp desktop client crafted specifically for the Linux desktop using Go, GTK 4, and Libadwaita.

ul.li: Native GNOME look and feel with full dark mode support
Instant QR-code pairing and live multi-device state synchronization
Voice messages with live recording waveform, pause/resume, and playback
Interactive WhatsApp polls with live vote percentage bars
WhatsApp Community grouping with collapsible server-style channels
Full WhatsApp call history (voice, video, incoming, outgoing, missed)
Inline emoji autocomplete with fuzzy search and popularity ranking
Live typing indicators and real-time online presence status
Clipboard image pasting and drag-and-drop file sharing
Custom per-chat solid colour and image wallpapers with adaptive window tinting and sidebar colour handles
Group creation, participant management, permissions, invite links/QR codes, and @mention autocomplete

description.p: WhatsDown v0.2.0 (Colourful) introduces custom per-chat wallpapers, window tinting, sidebar colour handles, full group management, and @mention autocomplete.

ul.li: Custom per-chat solid colour or image backgrounds, optional window/messagebar tinting, and sidebar colour handles
Group creator modal, group permissions, participant management, and invite link/QR code copying
Interactive @mention autocomplete with fuzzy search and clickable @mention rendering in message bubbles
Demo Mode for testing and screenshots without connecting a personal account
Fixed chat scroll locking, duplicate chats, community/titlebar avatar rendering, and profile picture rate limiting

description.p: Initial release of WhatsDown with full messaging, voice recordings, polls, communities, and call history.
